name: Retry an unsettled remittance
description: A processing main-to-game SBO remittance is confirmed by the provider on one scheduled retry.

statements.name: unsettled_remittance
statements.sql: INSERT INTO remittance_records (id, platform_id, station_id, user_id, no, txn_no, type, wallet_id, receipt_wallet_id, currency, amount, status, stage, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (100, 3, 1, 1, 'RE_SYNTHETIC_RETRY', 'SBO_SYNTHETIC_TXN', 'main2game', 1, 3, 'TWD', 25.0000, 'processing', 'situation', NOW(), NOW())

queries.name: remittance
queries.sql: SELECT id, no, txn_no, status, stage, amount, note, error_code, error_message FROM remittance_records WHERE id = 100

queries.name: wallets
queries.sql: SELECT id, balance, freeze FROM wallets WHERE id IN (1, 3) ORDER BY id

queries.name: transactions
queries.sql: SELECT id, user_id, model_type, model_id, model_no, wallet_id, platform_name, trade_type, currency, balance_original, balance_variable, balance_complete FROM transactions WHERE model_no = 'RE_SYNTHETIC_RETRY' ORDER BY id
